source.name: Texas A&M Aggie Map, University Building layer
source.attribution: Texas A&M University Facilities Analytics & Mapping
source.license_note: Public map data; no open license declared by the service. Not an OSM import.

scope: Original 24-place ordered-pair matrix at all 27 slots plus every added destination to/from Commons at 14:00; clear-sky test weather.
limitations: Only the current graph/raster bounds are covered.
Building pins connect to mapped outdoor walkways; entrances, opening hours and rooms are not surveyed.
Nearby buildings may share a walkway anchor and require adjusting a pin.
